title: Chapter 123 The First Batch Of Transactions
content:
Chapter 123 The First Batch Of Transactions

Wu Qing discovered that many races in this world are both native and foreign. The goblins are like this, and so are the humans.

It is said that the humans are also a large race in the evil god camp, and they are very powerful.

The goblins, a foreign race, are basically slaves of large races such as the bear goblins. They are only responsible for physical labor and have a very low status.

Their individual combat power is very weak, so the Zerg and the bear goblins have fought so many battles, but have not seen the goblins.

The goblins in the native camp are completely different. They rely on their own strength to gain the respect of the major native races.

Because the goblins have a low status in the evil god camp, they are the most determined invaders and one of the most active promoters and leaders in resisting the invasion of the evil god camp.

Wu Qing saw a corner of the powerful strength of the goblins from the transportation tools made by the goblins and the green little figure of the leader of this caravan.

"Independent Territory Alliance, welcome the caravan of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce!"

Meng, on behalf of the alliance, stepped forward to welcome the head of the caravan who got off the first transport.

The head of the caravan was just a tiny person in front of the tall Meng, but his momentum was not weak. Two robots that were much taller than Meng followed him.

These robots, called Guardians by the goblins, are all artificial mechanical creations, like those transport tools, driven by energy ore or more advanced energy coins.

They are equipped with various strange weapons and equipment, and under the control of the goblins, they are a very powerful fighting machine.

The Guardian is the main individual combat equipment of the goblin clan. After continuous development and improvement, there are many models of Guardians, with different sizes and quality strengths, and there are also differences between standard models and customized models.

The goblins drive Guardians of different models and equipped with different weapons, which can be suitable for wars of various intensities and environments.

Wu Qing feels that this thing is the same concept as the mecha, one is a product of the scientific and technological civilization of the interstellar era, and the other is a product of the energy civilization of this world.

"It's an honor for me, Gong Zhe from the Goblin Clan, to come to the territory of the Independent Territory Alliance. Thank you all the lords for welcoming me in person!"

The head of the caravan, whose name is translated as Gong Zhe, is very enthusiastic. He greeted Meng and the lords of the alliance with a smile on his face.

The names of this world are actually translated by the system according to Wu Qing's native language habits. The actual pronunciation and meaning of some names may be slightly different from what Wu Qing understands.

The system has given Wu Qing the ability to automatically understand languages. No matter what language he hears, it feels almost the same as listening to his native Chinese.

The name is just a reference. Wu Qing can distinguish people by their names, and there is no need to delve into these strange names.

Meng and the lords of the alliance are interested in making friends. Gong Zhe is also an experienced and versatile businessman. When they met, they quickly became familiar with each other.

The caravans in this world will travel along a certain route. Like traveling merchants, they will occasionally go to the branches of the Chamber of Commerce in various places to rest and replenish supplies, and will continue to sell the supplies traded along the way as commodities.

Under normal circumstances, caravans rarely go back, so Gong Zhe, the goblin, came here for the first time, and everyone didn't know each other.

"Our caravan just rested in the Chamber of Commerce not long ago, and brought a large number of high-quality goods and high-quality energy coins. Welcome to trade and buy!"

As a businessman, doing business is the main business. Seeing that the atmosphere is almost in place, Gong Zhe took out a large stack of commodity lists and distributed them to the lords of the alliance in person.

After each lord got the commodity list, he began to introduce the goods.

"We brought a lot of goods that everyone urgently needs this time, and the reserve of energy coins is also sufficient. Everyone can buy and exchange as much as they want!"

"The weapons and equipment brought by the caravan are well-made, diverse in style, and sufficient in stock. Welcome to buy!"

"There are many people of various races in the caravan, and some of them are very good at fighting. They all hope to be taken in by the lords!"

"..."

When Gong Zhe talked about his goods, he was very excited and talked endlessly!

The lords of the alliance also listened and carefully looked at the list of goods that Gong Zhe sent to them, looking for the goods they needed.

After Gong Zhe finished introducing the recommended goods at length, he looked at the lords of the alliance expectantly, waiting for the lords to place orders.

In such remote areas, it is a seller's market, and the caravan's goods are not worried about selling. Gong Zhe's hard work in introducing goods is just a professional habit.

The goblins are very professional and dedicated in creation and business. They strive to make every thing well and do every transaction well.

"I need all the tiger population!"

Meng was the first to place an order.

"I want all the fox population!"

"I want all the stone population!"

"I want all the feather population!"

"I want all the wolf population!"

"..."

Basically, every lord, if he has the ability, will give priority to purchasing the population of his own tribe. This is one of the fastest ways to strengthen the main race of the territory.

"I want all the human population."

The host representative Wu Qing placed an order.

Wu Qing is a human, and the main race in his original world is also human. An interstellar human base will eventually appear.

So, in this world, in addition to the Zerg, he will try his best to develop and expand the number of human races in the territory to prepare for the future.

In addition, among the native tribes in this world, the human race is the one that Wu Qing has the most hope to integrate into and develop by taking advantage of the situation.

Races like the Tengu tribe cannot include human races like Wu Qing in the core, no matter how strong Wu Qing is and how valuable he is.

The powerful races that can stand firm in this world have extremely strong real strength and foundation. The current Zerg in front of them is the difference between a small pond and the sea.

Fortunately, the development potential of the Zerg can reach the stars and the sea, and the power of the system is even more unfathomable. There is no problem for Wu Qing to join the Master Race in the future.

So he is not in a hurry. The development of anything requires a process.

This is a long-term strategic goal. What Wu Qing needs to do now is just a little bit of accumulation, and he does not need to invest too much energy in this regard.

…

Gong Zhe was so happy to see these lords placing orders so generously, and they were all orders to buy population.

The sooner these people who appeared in the caravan for various reasons and were waiting to be sold were sold, the better. The longer they stayed in the caravan, the higher their cost would be, and it would be even harder to sell them later.

The orders placed by the alliance lords cleared out a small half of the population of Gong Zhe's caravan, which was a good start!
